hookLine: Ranking the most brutal winter fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Slipping and eating pavement on a sheet of hidden ice.
Number 4: Faceplanting hard in the driveway mid-snowball fight.
Number 3: The sled crashing straight into a fence at full speed.
Number 2: Getting completely buried after falling backward into the snow.
Number 1: Ice skating turning into an instant, full-body wipeout!
